reference: Kirsch (1898) limit; Howland (1930) series values as tabulated in Peterson's Stress Concentration Factors (Pilkey & Pilkey, 3rd ed., Chart 4.1); Heywood (1952) fit K_tn = 2 + (1-d/W)^3
convention: K_tn = sigma_peak / sigma_net with sigma_net = T W/(W-d); K_tg = sigma_peak / T = K_tn (1-d/W)

model.symmetry: u_y=0 on y=0, u_x=0 on x=0
model.mesh: starburst rays from hole, arc-length boundary distribution, graded to hole

thin_plate_note: plane stress, small strain, isotropic, thin plate (t/W = 0.01); no contact, plasticity or geometric nonlinearity is exercised here
